levels.name: Novice
levels.privilege: Can download, vote on applications, use advanced search, and access the top 10.

levels.name: Member
levels.privilege: Can upload, send requests, create bookmarks, edit wiki pages, download multiple torrents at once, and reset own password/authkey.

levels.name: Elite
levels.privilege: Can access torrents notification system, create collections and a personal collection, create polls in forums, view snatch torrent lists, add own torrents to recommendations, display tag aliases, change password, and add artists to any group.
